summary: 1_Логошоты has 10 comps, the same in both .aep files. They cover: (a) two 16:9 UHD lockups of the cloud.ru logo plus a subline, built from 815×80 and 765×80 precomps (white plates that grow from a thin line, a 3D flip of the green cube, a subline plate that extends to the right, and a collapse at 3.32–4.32 s); (b) a 9:16 stack on dark plates, plus a left-aligned backup copy; (c) the 'без саблайна' logo sting (cube pops and slides, the wordmark wipes out from behind it), with and without a #222222 backing plate, at 1920×1080, nested at 135 % for 9:16. 5_Titles is a two-row speaker lower third on a 1500×500 canvas. A null named 'Размер плашек' scales the whole graphic to 250 %, so it is sized for UHD. It uses #222222 plates with a white leading edge one frame ahead of the plate (inverted-alpha matte), and SB Sans Text 40/30 px that rises by words or lines under alpha mattes. Everything is pure vector at 25 fps: no footage to relink, no long overlays, Classic 3D only, 0 expressions and no Essential Graphics. So every variable (plate and slogan widths, speaker text, outro geometry) is baked into keyframes, path vertices, duplicated layers and per-speaker or per-slogan comp copies. Also, the comps named 'Умное облако' actually display the live text 'облачные и ИИ-сервисы'. Plan: rebuild four master templates (CR_LowerThird, CR_LogoShot_Slogan 16:9, CR_LogoShot_Slogan 9:16, CR_LogoShot_Mark) on full-frame canvases, with sourceRectAtTime auto-sizing, slider-driven reveals, Responsive Design–Time and EGP. Ship them as mogrt for Pr and as Essential-Properties ae-templates for Ae, with prerenders and stills for the fixed logo variants and ffx / pr-presets for the recurring motion patterns. The decoded evidence (layer timing, switches, parent and matte IDs, keyframes, masks, text documents) is in C:/dev/temp/claude/C--Users------Documents-Cloud-ru-Preset-plugin/b48e0614-1141-4125-9b74-d00eb767441b/scratchpad/work/logo_titles/ (logo_pretty.txt, logo_conv_pretty.txt, titles_pretty.txt, titles_conv_pretty.txt), produced by deep.py, pretty.py and textdocs.py in the same folder.

templates.parametrization_plan: Master CR_LowerThird at 1920x1080 25p. UHD and 9:16 are made by the build script by changing CTRL scale and position; no 250 % null trick. Layers: CTRL (null: Position, Scale, Theme, sliders), TXT_Name and TXT_Title (point text at 100 %, SB Sans Text Regular 50 / 37.5 px at FHD, equal to today's 100/75 px at UHD), PL_Name and PL_Title, EDGE_Name and EDGE_Title. PL rects are left-anchored: Size = [(r.width + 2·padX)·Open/100, r.height + 2·padY] with r = TXT.sourceRectAtTime(time,false), and the rect position set to size/2. EDGE rects use the same size from Open.valueAtTime(time + thisComp.frameDuration), with an ALPHA-INV matte of their PL. Texts are ALPHA-matted by their PL and keep the existing Words and Lines rise animators, with the offset at 1.125× font size. CTRL sliders: Open (0→100, 0–0.80 s, ease 33/100; row 2 delayed 0.24 s via valueAtTime) and Close (exit toward the right edge as in the original, row 2 first, edge trailing one frame). No duplicated layers, masks, leading paragraph or box text. EGP: Name, Title (manual line break allowed), Show title (checkbox; hides row 2), Theme (Dark default; Light if approved), Edge colour (White | Green #26D07C), Position (point), Scale. Responsive Design–Time: intro 0–1.64 s and outro (last 1.08 s) protected; default duration 6 s, so editors stretch the hold in Pr. In Ae the panel imports CR_LowerThird.aep once, adds the master at the playhead as a precomp layer, writes Name and Title into the layer's Essential Properties and sets the out-point; Responsive Time keeps the intro and outro intact. No media slots.

problems.detail: The shared audit has gaps. It reports effects:{} for Логошот*.aep, but 'Layer 2 Outlines 2' carries ADBE Fill (inside a LIST sspc). The two Report.txt files here are UTF-8 with CR line breaks, not UTF-16. Parenting and track mattes can be decoded from ldta (164 B): s32 at 8 = stretch sign; bytes 36–39 = switches (b38: 0x80 null, 0x04 3D, 0x02 adjustment; b39: bit0 video, bit3 motion blur, bit6 shy, bit7 collapse); byte 107 = track-matte type (1 alpha, 2 alpha-inv, 3 luma, 4 luma-inv); u32 at 132 = parent ID; u32 at 160 = matte-layer ID. Keyframe time = s32(key[0:4]) / comp timescale + layer start; the lhd3 key size is at byte 18. AE omits properties that are at their default value. mkif chunks sit between tdmn and the mask LIST.
problems.fix: Reuse C:/dev/temp/claude/C--Users------Documents-Cloud-ru-Preset-plugin/b48e0614-1141-4125-9b74-d00eb767441b/scratchpad/work/logo_titles/deep.py and pretty.py for the other packs.

animation_patterns.name: Plate wipe-in with 1-frame white leading edge
animation_patterns.description: A #222222 rect anchored at its left edge scales X from 0 to W over 0.80 s (20 frames). Ease: the first key has out-influence 33.3 %, the landing key has in-influence 100 %, speeds 0, so it decelerates for a long time. W is baked today: 183.7 % / 113 %. A white #FFFFFF copy runs the identical curve one frame earlier (−0.04 s) with an ALPHA-INVERTED matte of the dark rect, so only a sliver at the moving edge shows; the edge layer is trimmed to the move (0.8 s). Row 2 starts 0.24 s (6 frames) later.
